summary: Roadzen Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a best-efforts offering of 4,705,870 ordinary shares at $1.70 per share, raising $7.999 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed on May 6, 2026, under an existing shelf registration. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. The placement agent, Maxim Group LLC, received a 6% cash fee and expense reimbursement. A 20-day lock-up restricts further equity issuance. This is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation, and no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved.
